title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Monthly Seat Fee Terms
content:
These terms govern the monthly seat fee of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement.

## Section 1. Invoicing of the monthly fee

1.1 The clause "The monthly fee for a service month is invoiced in advance on the monthly invoice day of that month and equals the per-seat rate times the billed seats, rounded half up to the cent" is **no longer in force** as a rule for every monthly fee. It no longer governs the monthly fee of the current service month (the calendar month of today's date) on an agreement whose seat ledger records no seat change taking effect between the first day of that month and the day the fee is posted and whose client holds at most one active Microsoft 365 F3 subscription and at most one active Microsoft 365 Business Premium subscription; such a fee is still invoiced in advance on the monthly invoice day of that month, and its amount follows the monthly seat-pricing schedule.

1.2 Every other monthly fee stays under this section: it is invoiced in advance on the monthly invoice day of that month and equals the per-seat rate multiplied by the billed seats, rounded half up to the cent.

## Section 2. Billed seats

2.1 Billed seats are the greater of the covered seats as they stood at the end of the last day of the previous month and the minimum-commitment floor, which is the contracted seats multiplied by the tier's minimum seat commitment percentage and divided by 100, rounded up to a whole seat.

2.2 Seats added on or after the first day of the service month are billed by proration, not by this fee.

## Section 3. First month, status and end of billing

3.1 The first service month after go-live is billed by the baseline proration charge, and the monthly fee starts with the first calendar month that begins after the go-live date.

3.2 A monthly fee may be invoiced only while the agreement status is active, suspended or notice given, as shown on the agreement's system record.

3.3 The fee continues during a suspension; no monthly fee is invoiced for a service month that begins after the termination effective date.

3.4 Payment is due the tier's net days calendar days after the posted date.

## Illustration of Sections 1.2 and 2.1 (hypothetical figures)

An agreement with 50 contracted seats on a tier whose commitment is 85 percent has a floor of 42.5, rounded up to 43 seats. With 40 covered seats at the end of the previous month, 43 seats are billed; at a per-seat rate of 110.00 a fee under Section 1.2 is 4730.00. With 47 covered seats, 47 seats are billed, 5170.00.
